steps.title: Analyze Build Error Logs
steps.description: Inspect compilation logs to identify the root cause of the compilation failure in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Verify App Configuration
steps.description: Confirm application package and metadata configurations inside app-meta.json.

steps.title: Identify Missing Imports
steps.description: Locate the missing RelativeLayout class reference inside MainActivity's inner classes.

steps.title: Add RelativeLayout Import
steps.description: Import android.widget.RelativeLayout in MainActivity.java to resolve class and LayoutParams reference errors.

steps.title: Validate Layout References
steps.description: Verify that all programmatic layout instantiation parameters are valid.

steps.title: Verify Adapter View Inflation
steps.description: Confirm programmatically constructed layouts in CategoryManagerAdapter render and delete correctly.

steps.title: Inspect NotesAdapter Layout
steps.description: Review programmatic layout structure in NotesAdapter for compile-time safety.

steps.title: Validate Java Standard Semantics
steps.description: Ensure strict Java 8 compatibility and syntax correctness across MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Confirm Android Manifest Integrations
steps.description: Verify relative path registrations and manifest integrity.

steps.title: Building NoteCraft
steps.description: Execute custom clean build task using Gradle to generate a verified error-free NoteCraft APK.
